schedule.reason: Owner confirmed Monday work until 22:00 Lima and Tuesday work 09:00-12:00 (3 hours). Remaining effort baseline unknown; no overnight work assumed or feasibility guarantee.
schedule.control: Freeze scope, estimate each reviewed execution sublot as a range, log actual duration/rework and announce forecast risk before starting added scope.
schedule.weighted_delivery_formula: 100 * sum(baseline effort of accepted scopes) / sum(baseline effort of all committed scopes); unavailable until remaining scope and effort are baselined.
schedule.forecast_formula: Remaining effort range / agreed daily capacity, respecting dependencies and non-working days; no forecast while inputs are unknown.
schedule.escalation: At the agreed lot budget boundary, stop optional expansion, record variance and propose the smallest remaining deliverable; do not silently extend scope or reduce acceptance.

reuse_policy: Select one primary lot and named acceptance seam before source reads/edits.

Record consumer/dependency hash changes, new contradiction or new requirement before any repeat validation.
Dependency drift triggers impact review, not blanket reruns.
Persist scope changes and revised forecast; never silently enlarge a time-boxed lot.
